coverage.target: U12 owns no PostgreSQL role, schema, migration, stored routine, or SQL path; persistence controls remain with data-owning services.
U12 owns no RabbitMQ publisher, consumer, outbox, inbox, durable replay, or business state; browser polling and SSE are presentation transports and do not replace provider-owned durable messaging.

U12 stores no authoritative operational log or business audit data and owns no retention maintenance; platform/U10 own seven/90-day retention, while U12 private state is disposable memory-only/no-store data.

U12 consumes the Helm and Terraform/Terragrunt platform supplied by U2/U13; infrastructure state, backend, apply serialization, backup, and migration evidence remain platform-infrastructure responsibilities.
